item.title: Industry rep says landlords face high cost renovating subdivided units as new law takes effect
item.description: An industry representative has said he is likely to spend some HK$160,000 to refit doors in a single flat and pay inspection fees, as the registration scheme for subdivided units took effect on Sunday. item.title: Hong Kong Arts Centre revives Asian film competition after 17-month hiatus, adds nat. security terms
item.description: The Hong Kong Arts Centre (HKAC) has revived an Asian film competition after a 17-month hiatus, adding new terms requiring participants to ensure their work complies with the city’s national security legislation. The HKAC’s Incubator for Film and Visual Media in Asia (ifva) Awards opened for applications on Sunday. According to the awards’ rules and […]

item.title: China backs Iran in ‘defending sovereignty,’ vows to push for peace
item.description: China’s Foreign Minister Wang Yi told his Iranian counterpart on a call Monday that Beijing supports Tehran defending itself against US-Israeli strikes, as war spread across the Middle East. item.title: Over 400 Hongkongers stranded in Middle East, reported safe amid conflict
item.description: More than 400 Hong Kong residents were stranded in the Middle East as of Monday afternoon, according to the Immigration Department, amid the ongoing conflict triggered by US-Israel strikes on Iran. item.title: China votes to oust 3 generals from political advisory body
item.description: China’s top political advisory body has voted to remove three generals, state media said, a week after nine military officials were ousted from its legislature. The move comes as Beijing escalates a sweeping purge of military officials, days before thousands of delegates from across the country meet for the annual Two Sessions political conclave on […]

item.title: Ex-Apple Daily editor files appeal for sentence cut in national security case
item.description: A former Apple Daily editor who was sentenced to 10 years in prison last month in a national security trial alongside his former boss, Jimmy Lai, has filed an appeal seeking a shorter sentence. Fung Wai-kong, former editorial writer and editor-in-chief of Apple Daily’s English news section, filed his appeal on Monday, local media reported, […]

item.description: A UK national security trial tied to the Hong Kong government is set to begin this week in London, as jury selection is under way. item.description: A British woman who was travelling in Hong Kong has been found guilty of blackmail and perverting the course of justice, after initially reporting a man for alleged rape in 2024.
